images.title: The mean of two numbers sits halfway
images.purpose: Shows that the mean of 3 and 7 is 5, exactly halfway between them.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One horizontal number line across the middle, two dots on it and a balance triangle under it.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal number line in dark outline with 11 evenly spaced tick marks for the whole numbers 0 to 10; only the ticks at 3, 5 and 7 carry numerals. Exactly two teal (#0072B2) dots of equal size sit on the line, one above 3 and one above 7. One filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) triangle points up to the line from below at 5, like a balance point. Above the line, two equal curved amber (#E69F00) arrows: one from 5 to 3 labelled 2 and one from 5 to 7 labelled 2. The word mean sits under the triangle. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The mean of two numbers is exactly halfway between them.
images.description: Shows that the mean of 3 and 7 is 5, exactly halfway between them.
images.context: Opening hook picture: mean of the pair 3 and 7.
images.teaching_notes: Same triangle style as the balance point image in the next topic.

image_decisions.why: The halfway picture makes the mean of two numbers visible as a centre, the idea the chapter builds on.
